correctness.rationale: For arbitrary m>=3 and algebraically closed k of any characteristic, two independent pivot columns must lie in distinct prescribed pairs. Each corresponding full Grassmannian affine chart is exactly A^2 times (m-2) independent affine rank-one 2x2 determinantal cones, with dimension 3m-4. The proper irreducible incidence Gr_B(2,sum L_i) proves support irreducible, while the charts prove reducedness and complete-intersection S2 and singular codimension3 gives R1, hence normality. In each chart the differential of det B=(d,-c,-b,a) vanishes only for zero block, yielding exactly m distinct irreducible components Y_i~=X_{m-1}. Local formal implicit functions convert nonzero blocks to smooth factors, and zero blocks to independent ordinary threefold nodes. Intersections Y_S~=X_{m-|S|} and degrees from regular Plücker hyperplane sections and two-row hook-length are exact. Symbolic tests for 2<=m<=8 and exhaustive GF(2)/GF(3) small m Jacobians replay VERIFY_OK; these are corroboration, not the infinite proof. Limits: reduced singular support only, no unreduced Jacobian scheme.

value.rationale: This natural rank-two matching/parallel-class positroid family provides a non-arbitrary infinite testbed for singularities of Grassmannian linear sections. The full component count and identities, intersection pattern, local product-of-nodes classification at every closed point, and reduced singular-support degree are substantive geometric invariants not determined solely by known general positroid normality or fixed-point smoothness criteria. The exact chart model is reusable for local geometry, and the smallest nontrivial case yields three disjoint Segre quadrics on a normal degree-14 fivefold. These are complete classifications of motivated structures, not isolated low-parameter statistics or a claimed improvement to the classical Grassmannian degree.
